aboutTeaser.title: A gallery, not a lot
aboutTeaser.body: Kian Auto Gallery has worked by the same simple rule since 2013: fewer cars, but every one inspected and documented. Instead of scrolling through hundreds of uncertain listings, you're looking at a short list we stand behind.

hero.subtitle: Kian Auto Gallery is a small showroom with one fixed rule: no car reaches the floor without a full inspection first.

timeline.title: From a small showcase to today

items.title: Getting started
items.body: We started with a small showcase and one simple promise: describe every car exactly as it is.

items.title: Adding technical inspection
items.body: We made a 150-point inspection a mandatory part of accepting any car into the gallery.

items.title: Right now
items.body: Dozens of cars with documented, transparent specs are ready for you to view in person.
